_comment: Act 3 script for the Meridian Resonance Institute and the finale.

objectives.power: Restore power: balance the generators on Level 1
objectives.descend: Take the stairs down to the living quarters
objectives.keycard: Find a research keycard in the living quarters
objectives.labs: Go down through the research labs
objectives.lock: Open the resonance lock to the Chamber

side_objectives.office: Optional: find Dr. Vance's private office (Level 3)

hints.sentinel: Sentinel cameras sweep in a cone. Stay out of the light, sneak underneath and cut the cable box on the wall (E), or switch them off at a security panel
hints.cable: One camera down. Each has its own cable box under it
hints.lasers: The laser grid is live. Restore power control to shut it down
hints.lock: The lock wants four tones in order. Lyra practised them somewhere on Level 2
hints.choir: Rings: jump or roll through. Marked ground: get off it. Strike the heart when it opens
hints.pillars: Strike all three resonance pillars to open the heart

arrive.speaker: Oren
arrive.text: You're through. I can hear the air handlers. Twenty years on backup power and the place is still breathing.

arrive.speaker: Oren
arrive.text: Cameras will still be live. They call whatever's nearby. Security desk can kill them.

power.speaker: Oren
power.text: Lights. There you go. Stairs are past the security desk.

quarters.speaker: Oren
quarters.text: Sixty families. There was a school room. Your sister ran rings round the teacher.

labs.speaker: Oren
labs.text: Signal's going, son. The deeper you get, the more it's her frequency and the less it's mine.

labs.speaker: Oren
labs.text: If I lose you: I'm still listening. I'll always be still listening.

archive.speaker: Kael
archive.text: "Waiting for someone to answer." ...I answered, Oren.

lock_open.speaker: Lyra
lock_open.text: That's it. That's the end of the song. You remembered it for me.

intro.speaker: Lyra
intro.text: Kael. You're inside. I can feel the door.

intro.speaker: Lyra
intro.text: It knows you're here too. It's so glad. It wants to hear you.

choir_intro.speaker: Lyra
choir_intro.text: Don't look at all of it at once. Look at the heart. That's where I am.
The Choir turns every voice it has toward him.

phase_2.speaker: Lyra
phase_2.text: It's calling them in. The pillars, Kael. They're how it holds on to me.

phase_3.speaker: Lyra
phase_3.text: I can see what it's going to do before it does it. Listen to me. Just listen to me.

ending.speaker: Lyra
ending.text: There. That's the note I've been holding. It's so heavy, Kael.

ending.speaker: Kael
ending.text: Then put it down. I've got it.

ending.speaker: Lyra
ending.text: If I let go, it ends. All of it. Me too, maybe.

ending.speaker: Kael
ending.text: You held a door shut for twenty years. Let me close it.

power: The generators are in the back room of reception.
The generator room is at the far end of reception, opposite the security office. Press E at the controls and spread the loads so no generator is over 50: 40 + 10, 30 + 20, 30 + 20.
descend: The stairs down are through reception's east doors.
Go through the doors at the east end of reception and down the stairs to Level 2.
keycard: The keycard is somewhere in the dormitories.
Look in Dormitory A, the room on the south side of the corridor: the keycard glows blue on a bunk.
labs: The card reader is by the east door.
Press E at the card reader beside the east door of Level 2 and take the stairs down to the labs.
lock: The lock wants four tones. Someone drew them on a wall.

Lyra drew the sequence on the classroom wall on Level 2: circle, triangle, diamond, square. Press E at the lock and play the tones in that order. A laser grid crosses the corridor: switch it off at the panel in Lab B.
chamber: Go through the open lock at the east end of the labs and down the last stairs.
choir: Hit the heart only while it is swollen and bright.
Jump the rings (Space) and stay off the burning edge. In the second phase strike the three pillars to open the heart; in the third, follow Lyra's calls.
sever: Walk up to the heart at the edge of the platform and press E.
